limitations: Official Nintendo product artwork and Ubisoft-published Steam screenshots are independently obtained external sources. The project sprite is never substituted as franchise authority.
The Ubisoft product HTML was reached, but its staticctf image CDN returned proxy403. This failed source is recorded, not bypassed. Official Nintendo and Steam image hosts returned200.
Rayman is small within the official scenes; inspection crops enlarge existing pixels only. Fine shoe seams, fabric microtexture, iris details and unseen angles are not certified.
Rayman Legends2013 is locked. Do not import Rayman Legends Retold2026, Origins costume differences, Rayman3 gloves, Rabbids or another franchise.
Age is not established by the inspected sources. Keep source cartoon proportions, family-safe scenes and no romance; never invent adulthood.
New scenes are original settings coherent with inspected Glade of Dreams medieval woodland, painted ruins and mythical coast imagery, not claimed copies of canon screenshots.
CG02 is an explicitly What If display of accessory replicas, not a claim that Rayman owns removable weapons or that anatomical hands were severed.

CG13 chooses genderSwap only and preserves limbless source anatomy and source age; CG15 interprets the first crossing into a painting at the Legends opening, without claiming a new age or exact canonical still.
Independent visual review is required for every produced native; no perfect1:1 fidelity certification is inferred from images, names or checksums.

observations.individualReview: Six separated physical elements with visible background gaps: detached head, purple sleeveless torso, two white gloves and two shoes. Both open gloves show thumb plus three fingers, no neck/arms/legs. White hollow belly ring, red hood/drawstrings, gold-orange hair and large nose agree with qualified Legends references. Entire silhouette and shoes contained. Actual expression is a broad surprised happy open-mouth smile, not the quiet expression of the initial brief; forest path and stone arch form a new coherent setting.
